title: Horizontal comparison homotopy for Cartan--Eilenberg rows
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in $\mathcal A$. Let $I^{p,q}$ and $J^{p,q}$ be first-quadrant double complexes [def-sp-double-complex-total] with augmentations $\epsilon_I:K^\bullet\to I^{\bullet,0}$ and $\epsilon_J:L^\bullet\to J^{\bullet,0}$. Assume each augmented column $0\to K^p\xrightarrow{\epsilon_I^p}I^{p,0}\to I^{p,1}\to\cdots$ is exact, each $J^{p,\bullet}$ is a bounded-below complex of injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the augmented boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows of $I$ are exact, and the corresponding rows of $J$ are injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $\delta:I\to J$ be a morphism of double complexes. Suppose a cochain map $w:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ has a homotopy $s^p:K^p\to L^{p-1}$ with $w^p=d_L^{p-1}s^p+s^{p+1}d_K^p$ and $\delta^{p,0}\epsilon_I^p=\epsilon_J^p w^p$. Then there are maps $s_1^{p,q}:I^{p,q}\to J^{p-1,q}$, with $s_1^{p,0}\epsilon_I^p=\epsilon_J^{p-1}s^p$, such that each $s_1^{p,\bullet}$ is a map of column complexes (so $d_v s_1=s_1d_v$), and $R=\delta-d_hs_1-s_1d_h$ is a morphism of vertical complexes that vanishes on the augmented horizontal row.

proof.text: For a natural-indexed complex M with a quasi-isomorphism e:X[0]→M, use the already proved CochainComplex.exact₀_of_quasiIso_single₀ e and CochainComplex.exact_succ_of_quasiIso_single₀ e n from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Resolution. They give exactness of X→M⁰→M¹ and Mⁿ→Mⁿ⁺¹→Mⁿ⁺². The same module supplies mono_f_zero_of_quasiIso_single₀: e⁰ is monic, since the quasi-isomorphism identifies X with the degree-zero cycles kernel. These are proved library facts; the private lift helper reuses them without reconstructing the kernel.

Given a closed map f:X→N⁰ into a natural-indexed complex N of injectives, extend it along the monomorphism e⁰ using Injective.factorThru to obtain a₀. Since e⁰a₀d_N=f d_N=0, exactness of (e⁰,d_M) and Exact.descToInjective give a₁ with a₀d_N=d_Ma₁. Inductively, if aₙd_N=d_Maₙ₊₁, then d_Maₙ₊₁d_N=aₙd_Nd_N=0; positive-degree exactness and injectivity of Nⁿ⁺² extend aₙ₊₁d_N to aₙ₊₂. CochainComplex.mkHom assembles these components. Apply this proved helper to M=I.X p, N=J.X(p−1), e=eI.f p and f=s p followed by (eJ.f(p−1)).f 0. The last map is closed because eJ.f(p−1) is a complex morphism from Lᵖ⁻¹[0]. Choose the resulting column maps for all p. This works for every integer p, so the first-quadrant and horizontal-row assumptions are not needed for this conclusion.

Define R p=δ.f p−s₁ p≫J.d(p−1,p)−I.d(p,p+1)≫s₁(p+1)≫J.XIsoOfEq((p+1)−1=p).hom. Each term has the type of a column-complex morphism. Evaluate the horizontal commutation equations for eI and eJ in vertical degree zero. The augmentation equation for s₁ rewrites the first correction to s p≫L.d(p−1,p)≫eJᵖ; the second rewrites to K.d(p,p+1)≫s(p+1)≫L.XIsoOfEq((p+1)−1=p).hom≫eJᵖ. Naturality of the equality-transport isomorphism is proved by equality elimination. Using haug, precomposition of R with eIᵖ is therefore (wᵖ−s p≫L.d(p−1,p)−K.d(p,p+1)≫s(p+1)≫L.XIsoOfEq.hom)≫eJᵖ, which is zero by hhom and additive cancellation.

lean.statement: theorem horizontal_comparison_lift (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] (K L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (I J : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (eI : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ I) (eJ : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L ⟶ J) (δ : I ⟶ J) (hFirstI : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (I.X p)) (hFirstJ : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (J.X p)) (hExactI : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (eI.f p)) (hInjectiveJ : ∀ (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Injective ((J.X p).X q)) (hRowsI : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap eI p) ∧ QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' (eI.f (p - 1)) (eI.f p) (eI.comm (p - 1) p))) ∧ QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eI p)) (hRowsJ : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap eJ p) ∧ QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' (eJ.f (p - 1)) (eJ.f p) (eJ.comm (p - 1) p))) ∧ QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eJ p)) (hRowInjectiveJ : ∀ (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Injective ((J.cycles p).X q) ∧ Injective ((image (J.d (p - 1) p)).X q) ∧ Injective ((J.homology p).X q)) (w : K ⟶ L) (s : ∀ p : ℤ, K.X p ⟶ L.X (p - 1)) (hhom : ∀ p : ℤ, w.f p = s p ≫ L.d (p - 1) p + K.d p (p + 1) ≫ s (p + 1) ≫ (L.XIsoOfEq (Int.add_sub_cancel p 1)).hom) (haug : ∀ p : ℤ, (eI.f p).f 0 ≫ (δ.f p).f 0 = w.f p ≫ (eJ.f p).f 0) : ∃ (s₁ : ∀ p : ℤ, I.X p ⟶ J.X (p - 1)) (R : ∀ p : ℤ, I.X p ⟶ J.X p), (∀ p : ℤ, (eI.f p).f 0 ≫ (s₁ p).f 0 = s p ≫ (eJ.f (p - 1)).f 0) ∧ (∀ p : ℤ, R p = δ.f p - s₁ p ≫ J.d (p - 1) p - I.d p (p + 1) ≫ s₁ (p + 1) ≫ (J.XIsoOfEq (Int.add_sub_cancel p 1)).hom) ∧ (∀ p : ℤ, (eI.f p).f 0 ≫ (R p).f 0 = 0)
